label: Atlas Core
description: The infrastructure layer: librarian, status manager, estimability manager, layer connector. Owns no biological products of its own.

label: Inversion Atlas
description: Discovery + karyotyping + pair-relation of inversion candidates inside the 226-cohort. Manuscript stress test: LG01 × LG28 pair-relation. Popstats split out to popstats_atlas; cross-species coordinates split out to cross_species_atlas.

label: Relatedness Atlas
description: ngsRelate → ngsPedigree → Mendelian QC chain. Provides the relatedness backbone that meiosis + manuscript path A depend on.

label: Meiosis Atlas
description: Dyads / triads / CO / DCO / coefficient-of-coincidence + interchromosomal effects of inversions on meiosis.

label: Cross-Species Atlas
description: Comparative breakpoint detection across 18 catfish genomes + hybrid subgenomes. Two independent method families (gene-order via BUSCO; sequence via wfmash). Headline: LG27 bounded inversion (12.43 + 16.50 Mb), LG23 @ 4.04 Mb cross-method validated. Strictly COORDINATE-only — hands genome coordinates to inversion_atlas; never makes claims about hatchery samples.

label: Popstats Atlas
description: Window-wise population genetics between karyotype groups. Wraps region_popstats's groupwise mode (FST / dxy / piN / piS) + decomposed slices (fst_pairwise / dxy / theta_pi). Manuscript path B target inside the LG28 candidate.

label: Evolution Atlas
description: Arrangement origin, selection scenarios, evolution summary. Reads cross_species breakpoint catalog + inversion karyotypes + meiosis effects to argue mechanism + ancestry.

label: Genome / Synteny Atlas (deprecated)
description: Folded into cross_species_atlas. Use cross_species_atlas for comparative breakpoint + synteny coordinates.

label: Marker Design
description: Per-inversion + interchromosomal marker panels; assay readiness.

label: Diversity Atlas
description: Per-sample + windowed diversity statistics on the 226-hatchery cohort. Genome-wide individual heterozygosity, folded 1D SFS, ANGSD doThetaStat windowed θπ / θW, multi-scale window stacks. Substrate for popstats path B + manuscript supplementary diversity tables.

label: Genome Atlas
description: F1 hybrid (C. gariepinus × C. macrocephalus) assembly-paper deliverables. Renders cluster-baked outputs: assembly metrics, BRAKER + Liftoff gene tracks, EDTA repeats, Cactus + macrosyntR synteny, WGDI ancestral karyotype, OrthoFinder orthology. Cohort is DIFFERENT from the 226-hatchery; coordinates only, no hatchery claims.
